title: Query Package Manager for Nginx Status
objective: Use the identified package manager to check if the Nginx package is installed.
rationale: This is the most reliable way to confirm if the system believes Nginx is installed, regardless of binary path.
expected_output: A boolean result indicating if the 'nginx' package is installed.
success_criteria: The package manager command executes without error.
The output explicitly confirms the presence or absence of the 'nginx' package.
